sections.label: Standing Orders amendments review
sections.summary: The House will make consequential amendments to the Standing Orders from the Elected Presidency constitutional amendments and conduct a general review, with written submissions due to the Clerk by 17 March 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: First, to make consequential amendments to the Standing Orders arising from the constitutional amendments principally in relation to the Elected Presidency Scheme that were passed by this House last November.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Second, to take the opportunity to do a more general review, to ensure that this House continues to have an efficient set of procedures to support its work.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Members can make written submissions to the Standing Orders Committee if they have any amendments to propose.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The submissions should be sent to the Clerk by Friday, 17 March 2017.
